name: Cupboard cooker
summary: A toy: the friend's rice cooker on the counter with the lid up. Everyone drops in one thing from the cupboard, anyone flips the switch, it steams and rattles and dings, and out comes a bowl named from whatever went in. Then empty it and go again.
useWhen: arun's rice cooker makes everything, let's test it
what can we make with what's left in the cupboard, everyone pick one thing
bored at the apartment, something silly to do together
a chaotic dinner idea from random ingredients
cupboard roulette, what would the rice cooker make
dontUseWhen: an actual recipe or meal plan (use reel-cook-night)
deciding where to order from (use dinner-veto)

owner.description: Whose rice cooker it is, by name

pantry.description: Up to 8 things in the cupboard in the chat's words, each with kind for the drawing: egg, cheese, chili, green, meat, sauce, crunch or sweet

added.description: Who already dropped what in (pantry labels), one each

verdict.description: What the owner says when it dings, in their words
